review_type: Targeted literature synthesis; not systematic review

sources.title: The next Big Five Inventory (BFI-2): Developing and assessing a hierarchical model with 15 facets to enhance bandwidth, fidelity, and predictive power
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.population: Adult Internet volunteers; predominantly US; separate student sample
sources.major_findings: Hierarchical trait measurement; Tables 2 and 5 supply domain correlations and moments.
sources.limitations: Convenience sampling; summary moments do not identify a complete joint distribution.

sources.title: The implications of Big Five standing for the distribution of trait manifestation in behavior: Fifteen experience-sampling studies and a meta-analysis
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.major_findings: Traits relate to distributions of states alongside considerable within-person variation.
sources.limitations: Does not identify the probability of a particular simulated action.

sources.title: Empirical, theoretical, and practical advantages of the HEXACO model of personality structure
sources.major_findings: Alternative six-dimensional structure includes honesty-humility.
sources.limitations: Not simply Big Five plus an independent extra score.

sources.title: How universal is the Big Five? Testing the five-factor model of personality variation among forager-farmers in the Bolivian Amazon
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.major_findings: Canonical factor recovery did not transfer straightforwardly.
sources.limitations: Instrument, sampling and administration constrain interpretation.

sources.title: How Replicable Are Links Between Personality Traits and Consequential Life Outcomes? The Life Outcomes of Personality Replication Project
sources.major_findings: Most associations replicated in the expected direction, with smaller effects overall.
sources.limitations: Association does not establish a causal daily rule.

sources.title: Emotion-based dispositions to rash action: Positive and negative urgency
sources.major_findings: Emotion-related urgency differs from sensation seeking and planning/perseverance deficits.
sources.limitations: Evidence base and measurement are not a validated simulator.

sources.title: A domain-specific risk-attitude scale: Measuring risk perceptions and risk behaviors
sources.major_findings: Risk perceptions and behavioral willingness differ by content domain.
sources.limitations: No universal risk scalar or calibrated probability for Jordan.

sources.title: Much ado about grit: A meta-analytic synthesis of the grit literature
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.methodology: Meta-analysis of construct and outcome associations
sources.major_findings: Grit overlaps strongly with conscientiousness; perseverance has stronger utility than consistency of interests.
sources.limitations: Avoid duplicating correlated persistence predictors.

sources.title: Temperament, stress reactivity, and coping: Implications for depression in childhood and adolescence
sources.journal: Journal of Clinical Child and Adolescent Psychology
sources.major_findings: Temperament, reactivity and coping are related but distinct developmental constructs.
sources.limitations: Child/adolescent synthesis does not calibrate an adult simulation.

sources.title: Self-schemata and processing information about the self
sources.major_findings: Self-schemas relate to processing of self-relevant information.
sources.limitations: No general numeric updating law extracted.

sources.title: Relational schemas and the processing of social information
sources.major_findings: Self-in-relation, representations of others and interaction scripts organize relational information.
sources.limitations: Conceptual framework, not fitted simulation dynamics.

sources.title: Cognitive processes mediating behavioral change
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.major_findings: Efficacy expectations relate to domain-specific behavioral change.
sources.limitations: Specific task and intervention; not universal success probability.

sources.title: The Experiences in Close Relationships—Relationship Structures Questionnaire: A method for assessing attachment orientations across relationships
sources.major_findings: Relationship-specific representations add information beyond general measures.
sources.limitations: Attachment dimensions are not equivalent to a support probability.

sources.title: The changing signs in the relationships among self-efficacy, personal goals, and performance
sources.methodology: Repeated task performance and efficacy analyses
sources.major_findings: Efficacy-performance relationships vary with design and level of analysis.
sources.limitations: Does not imply that efficacy is always harmful.

sources.title: Neural and computational processes underlying dynamic changes in self-esteem
sources.methodology: Computational modeling of social feedback and self-esteem
sources.major_findings: Prediction errors help model task-specific changes in self-evaluation.
sources.limitations: Transfer to everyday relationship support is unvalidated.

sources.title: The link between self-esteem and social relationships: A meta-analysis of longitudinal studies
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.sample_size: 48 samples n=46231; reverse direction 35 samples n=21995
sources.major_findings: Reciprocal associations between social relationships and self-esteem.
sources.limitations: Pooled prospective coefficients are not per-event learning rates.

sources.title: A Manifesto on Psychology as Idiographic Science: Bringing the Person Back Into Scientific Psychology, This Time Forever
sources.methodology: Analysis of assumptions connecting levels of analysis
sources.major_findings: Between-person estimates need not describe within-person dynamics.
sources.limitations: Methodological argument does not supply a replacement parameterization.
sources.access_level: indexed original author paper via university repository

sources.title: Self-determination theory and the facilitation of intrinsic motivation, social development, and well-being
sources.major_findings: Autonomy, competence and relatedness organize basic psychological needs.
sources.limitations: Theory does not estimate the current action coefficients.

sources.title: Intrinsic and extrinsic motivations: Classic definitions and new directions
sources.major_findings: Extrinsic motivation varies in relative autonomy.
sources.limitations: Do not reduce all extrinsic motives to one negative score.

sources.title: A meta-analytic review of experiments examining the effects of extrinsic rewards on intrinsic motivation
sources.major_findings: Reward effects vary with form, expectation and contingency.
sources.limitations: Interpretation disputed by other syntheses; no generic penalty justified.

sources.title: Pervasive negative effects of rewards on intrinsic motivation: The myth continues
sources.methodology: Alternative grouping and meta-analysis of contingencies
sources.major_findings: Broad reward harm is contested; interest and contingencies moderate effects.
sources.limitations: Not a claim that every reward improves motivation.

sources.title: From expectancy-value theory to situated expectancy-value theory: A developmental, social cognitive, and sociocultural perspective on motivation
sources.major_findings: Expectancy, value components and costs depend on context and development.
sources.limitations: An educational framework is not a universal numeric action formula.

sources.title: Refining the theory of basic individual values
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.major_findings: Nineteen values organize compatible and conflicting motivational concerns.
sources.limitations: Circumplex structure is not an exact fixed covariance or personality type.

sources.title: Personality traits and personal values: A meta-analysis
sources.major_findings: Traits and values have patterned associations but remain distinct.
sources.limitations: Separate meta-analyses may share primary studies; no complete joint prior.

sources.title: Motivational basis of personality traits: A meta-analysis of value-personality correlations
sources.major_findings: Trait-value associations vary with context including threat.
sources.limitations: Not an individually deterministic cultural rule.

sources.title: A theory of goal systems
sources.major_findings: Goals can share means or compete for resources.
sources.limitations: No fitted coefficients extracted.
sources.access_level: original publisher preview and university metadata

sources.title: A cognitive-affective system theory of personality: Reconceptualizing situations, dispositions, dynamics, and invariance in personality structure
sources.major_findings: Stable situation-dependent patterns can coexist with behavioral variability.
sources.limitations: Organizing framework does not validate this engine.

sources.title: Cybernetic Big Five Theory
sources.methodology: Cybernetic account of traits and adaptations
sources.major_findings: Traits and characteristic adaptations have distinct explanatory roles.
sources.limitations: Whole simulation cannot inherit validation from a theory.
sources.access_level: original publisher abstract and indexed author paper

sources.title: Personality stability and change: A meta-analysis of longitudinal studies
sources.sample_size: Rank-order: 189 samples n=178503; mean-level: 276 samples n=242542
sources.methodology: Meta-analysis of rank-order and mean-level change
sources.major_findings: Stability and mean-level development vary over the lifespan.
sources.limitations: Aggregate age patterns do not determine individual trajectories.

sources.title: A systematic review of personality trait change through intervention
sources.methodology: Mixed designs including pre-post and experimental studies
sources.major_findings: Trait measures changed during interventions averaging about 24 weeks.
sources.limitations: Design heterogeneity; not a daily trait learning rate or proof of this model.

sources.title: Individual differences in personality change across the adult life span
sources.major_findings: Individual change trajectories differ across adulthood.
sources.limitations: Specific sample and measurement; no universal slope.

sources.title: An attributional theory of achievement motivation and emotion
sources.major_findings: Locus, stability and controllability distinguish perceived causes.
sources.limitations: Attribution is subjective; no hidden cause may be treated as observed.

sources.title: Approach–avoidance motivation in personality: Approach and avoidance temperaments and goals
sources.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.major_findings: Approach and avoidance dispositions connect with goal processes.
sources.limitations: Overlapping constructs should not be independent duplicate action bonuses.
sources.access_level: indexed original paper via university repository

sources.title: Basic psychological need satisfaction, need frustration, and need strength across four cultures
sources.major_findings: Need satisfaction and frustration are distinguishable experiences across studied cultures.
sources.limitations: Four cultures do not establish universality or calibrated simulation rates.
sources.access_level: original publisher abstract; full author list not transcribed
sources.metadata_note: Verified lead authors: Beiwen Chen, Maarten Vansteenkiste, Wim Beyers; complete author list not transcribed.

sources.title: The need to belong: Desire for interpersonal attachments as a fundamental human motivation
sources.major_findings: Stable interpersonal bonds are a broad motivational concern.
sources.limitations: No fixed contact preference or action probability follows.

sources.title: Permission to Use the IPIP
sources.major_findings: IPIP items and scales are public domain.
sources.limitations: This permission does not cover BFI-2, NEO or arbitrary derivative validation.
